purpose: Official retained interface examples plus a labelled synthetic asset scenario. All implementation and measurement remain pending.
original_acceptance: The minimum implementation consumes valid named inputs and meets the reviewed behavior cases; examples/templates alone do not establish completion.
Every mandatory artifact exists or maps to agreed equivalent sections; preserve original evidence and disclose unresolved failures.

Publish the specified baseline/metric results with denominators, measured/not-run state and limitations. A negative result may satisfy research acceptance if the protocol and artifact requirements are met.

asset_research_plan.decision: One deterministic resolver for approved enrollment identities on two sources, returning associate, distinct or needs_review. Preserve observations and reasons. Begin with a small conflict corpus; cross-source auto-merge is gated.
questions: Which identity signals survive IP changes, re-enrollment and host cloning, and which conflicts must block an automatic association?
How can a resolution be reproduced from immutable observations and a rule revision without deleting earlier identities?
What evidence would reverse an incorrect association, and how will the consumer see that correction?
Which smallest implementation answers the declared project need, and what evidence would make the extension unnecessary?
asset_research_plan.comparison: Use the existing enrolled-ID rules as the main baseline. IP-only matching is a diagnostic weak comparator, not the only method to beat.
cases: Same enrollment, changed address — An address change alone does not create a different enrolled host.
Address reused by a different enrollment — An address is not sufficient host identity.
Conflicting concurrent claims — A copied identifier or conflicting claim must remain visible; exact equality alone cannot erase a known conflict.
consumers: C18: resolved host identity for chronological asset deltas.
C22: reviewed false-merge/false-split outcomes for the asset benchmark.
D08/P02 reviewers: compatible host references; product matching and persistence stay with their owners.
asset_research_plan.reviewers: Mahrous reviews identity ambiguity and product-matching separation; Omar checks persistence/auth compatibility.
asset_research_plan.start: Activate only when at least two observation sources or demonstrated identity conflicts require it. The initial enrolled-asset path in C03/C05 must work without this extension.
